fato_historico: 1940: In Mexico City, exiled Russian revolutionary Leon Trotsky is fatally wounded with an ice axe by Ramón Mercader. He dies the next day.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may feel a shift in perspective today. Just as history reminds us that even sharp edges cannot dampen the power of an enduring idea, consider how your thoughts shape your reality. It is a good time to sharpen your focus on communication and leave behind any outdated mental barriers that no longer serve your creative growth.
frase_do_dia: Your mind is a brilliant garden where endless possibilities wait to bloom beautifully.
significado_numero: A master number representing the manifestation of dreams into tangible reality.
conselho: Trust your intuition and speak your truth with grace and gentle confidence today.
